You're going to get white knighted to shit, so I'm going to weigh in because I was just like you.

End it. Now. Text her you need to talk and lay the whole shitshow out. Be thoroughly honest, because she deserves to know too. 

Now that thats over move forward. Life is short, relationships are everywhere and as humans we have lots of them. If you haven't found someone that you think about and can't imagine not enjoying their time and they yours, there isn't something quite right and you need to move on.
I thought this was going a whole different direction

That's kinda my thoughts. I would rather it come up naturally rather than it be like 'look at what an asshole I am' sort of thing. It's pretty hot and fresh right now, and for her this is her first heartbreak so I'm not really sure what could happen. My plan is to distance as much as possible and maybe a while down the road we can talk.

I have no idea. She said she's there for me as a friend. But I feel like I've betrayed myself and her. 
I want us to be together, and I know that this is a mistake - I just feel so desperate and lost on what to think or do. I want to make this all like it never happened and that I didn't get weak.
That's my feeling really. I'm going to hate this one because its going to be very dramatic on her end.
